title: Singapore Secondary 1 G3 Mathematics
description: A course-led preparation path for Singapore Secondary 1 G3 Mathematics, beginning with N1 Numbers and their operations.
subject: Mathematics

lessons.title: Primes and prime factorisation
lessons.summary: Identify prime numbers and express positive integers as products of prime factors using index notation.
objectives: Identify whether a positive integer is prime or composite.
Write a positive integer as a product of prime factors in index notation.

lessons.title: HCF, LCM, squares, cubes and roots
lessons.summary: Use prime factorisation to find HCF, LCM, squares, cubes, square roots and cube roots.
objectives: Find the HCF and LCM of positive integers using prime factors.
Recognise and calculate square, cube, square-root and cube-root relationships.

lessons.title: Number sets and operations
lessons.summary: Classify and calculate with negative numbers, integers, rational numbers and real numbers.
objectives: Distinguish integers, rational numbers and real numbers.
Apply the four operations accurately to signed and rational numbers.

lessons.title: Calculator calculations
lessons.summary: Enter, interpret and check multi-step numerical calculations with a calculator.
objectives: Enter expressions with powers, roots, brackets and fractions correctly.
Use estimation to decide whether a calculator result is reasonable.

lessons.title: Number lines and ordering
lessons.summary: Represent, compare and order positive and negative values on a number line.
objectives: Locate integers, fractions and decimals on a number line.
Order mixed positive and negative values accurately.

lessons.title: Inequalities
lessons.summary: Express comparisons using less than, greater than, less than or equal to, and greater than or equal to.
objectives: Choose the correct inequality symbol for a comparison.
Describe all integers satisfying a compound inequality.

lessons.title: Approximation and estimation
lessons.summary: Round values to decimal places or significant figures and estimate numerical results.
objectives: Round positive and negative values to a stated accuracy.
Use rounded values and bounds to estimate and interpret results.
